choose.when:
<set-variable name="backendBody" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
                
                    @($"Foundry returned {context.Response.StatusCode} {context.Response.StatusReason}: {(string)context.Variables["backendBody"]}")
                    
                
                
                    application/json
                
                
                @{
                    var raw = (string)context.Variables["backendBody"];
                    JToken detail;
                    try { detail = JToken.Parse(raw); } catch { detail = raw; }
                    var headers = context.Response.Headers;
                    return new JObject(
                        new JProperty("source", "foundry-backend"),
                        new JProperty("statusCode", context.Response.StatusCode),
                        new JProperty("reason", context.Response.StatusReason),
                        new JProperty("backendRequestId", headers.GetValueOrDefault("apim-request-id", headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-request-id", ""))),
                        new JProperty("wwwAuthenticate", headers.GetValueOrDefault("WWW-Authenticate", "")),
                        new JProperty("gatewayRequestId", context.RequestId.ToString()),
                        new JProperty("backendError", detail)
                    ).ToString();
                }
